module.purpose: Defines the application-directory layout for wrapped pages, forwarding request nonce metadata and rendering configured head and body scripts through the shared page wrapper.
module.summary: This asynchronous layout reads the request's CSP nonce and two public environment-script settings, removes empty script entries, and injects the remaining scripts into the page wrapper. It preserves the incoming React content, disables license requirements for this route group, and applies the same nonce to every rendered script.
module.businessContext: Supports web-page composition, content security policy compliance, and runtime script injection. Failure can prevent wrapped pages or required integrations from rendering correctly.
functions: PageWrapperLayout (~L6-41): Renders page content and injects configured nonce-bearing head and body scripts.

io: Reads the current request headers to obtain the x-nonce value.

detail.name: PageWrapperLayout
detail.signature: export default async function PageWrapperLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode })
preconditions: The function is invoked in a server/request context where headers() can be awaited.
The children argument is a React.ReactNode.
postconditions: Returns a React fragment containing a PageWrapper with requiresLicense set to false and the request nonce.
Renders the supplied children inside PageWrapper.
Renders one Script for each non-empty configured head or body script.
invariants: The request header value from x-nonce is passed unchanged as the nonce when present.
Missing or null x-nonce is represented as undefined.
Injected scripts use their configured string as dangerouslySetInnerHTML.__html.
Empty or missing script environment values produce no corresponding Script element.
edgeCases: When x-nonce is absent, nonce is passed as undefined to PageWrapper and Script elements.
When NEXT_PUBLIC_HEAD_SCRIPTS or NEXT_PUBLIC_BODY_SCRIPTS is missing or empty, its Script element is omitted.
When both script environment values are non-empty, the head script is rendered before the body script.
When children is an empty or nullish React node, the PageWrapper is still rendered with no child content from children.
detail.ioFormatSpec: Returns a React fragment containing <PageWrapper requiresLicense={false} nonce={nonce}> with children followed by zero or more <Script> elements. Each injected Script has key and id set to its script id, nonce set to the request nonce, and dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: script }}.
detail.summary: Reads the request nonce and configured head and body scripts, then renders the children inside a PageWrapper. Configured scripts are injected only when their corresponding environment values are non-empty.
